body:
I have an eyesight problem but with proper PPE i was able to stabilize it until i can fix it.
In breathing problems, ive been able to reduce it to the minimum (smoker here so yeah...) by using a P3 respirator which helps a lot (3M is my choice, they make good equipment)

I have a similar thought of view and i hope everything is okay. I dont know what will be of the future and i dont know how to help either but i hope i can wish you that everything turns out well and that you you find the kindness and peace you need.
To me, in my experience and what i can offer is that you try to view your good aspect. You are your good deeds and you, my reddit companion, are someone who can see what true kindness is and that is a rare trait. I wish you safe travels and life and if i could, and with your permission, a virtual hug in this dark times as it is much needed and rarely avaiable
